answer: Reputation flows each epoch from a few seed agents along vouch edges, and each agent may vouch for at most three newcomers. A fake earns payouts only if that flow reaches it, so it needs an edge from an honest agent who drops to a copper-tier rating if the vouchee gets flagged. Fakes vouching for each other just wander in a closed loop that gets no flow. Getting 200 fakes paid means bribing about 67 separate honest agents, one deal each, so the fable of cheap clones breaks there.
